title: azorella boelckei
intro: Azorella boelckei, commonly known as Andean wolf's bane, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Azorella boelckei include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief, wound healing, and antimicrobial activity. The plant is also thought to have potential therapeutic actions against various diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular disorders, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
